# NIST 800-53

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by `npm run gen-docs` — do not edit by hand. -->

NIST SP 800-53 additions on top of `coreSecurity`.

**13 rules.**

---

## Rules

### `rule-1`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_iam_account_password_policy`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require minimum_password_length >= 14
- **Message:** IAM password policy: minimum length must be at least 14 characters
- **Rationale:** NIST IA-5(1) — minimum password length
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST IA-5(1) — minimum password length

### `rule-2`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_iam_account_password_policy`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require = true: require_symbols
- **Message:** IAM password policy must require symbols
- **Rationale:** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity

### `rule-3`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_iam_account_password_policy`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require = true: require_numbers
- **Message:** IAM password policy must require numbers
- **Rationale:** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity

### `rule-4`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_iam_account_password_policy`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require = true: require_uppercase_characters
- **Message:** IAM password policy must require uppercase characters
- **Rationale:** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity

### `rule-5`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_iam_account_password_policy`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require = true: require_lowercase_characters
- **Message:** IAM password policy must require lowercase characters
- **Rationale:** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST IA-5(1) — password complexity

### `rule-6`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_iam_account_password_policy`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require password_reuse_prevention >= 5
- **Message:** IAM password policy must prevent reuse of at least 5 passwords
- **Rationale:** NIST IA-5(1) — password history
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST IA-5(1) — password history

### `rule-7`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_iam_account_password_policy`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require max_password_age <= 90
- **Message:** IAM password policy: max password age must be at most 90 days
- **Rationale:** NIST IA-5(1) — password expiration
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST IA-5(1) — password expiration

### `rule-8`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_redshift_cluster`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require = true: encrypted
- **Message:** Redshift clusters must be encrypted
- **Rationale:** NIST SC-28 — protect information at rest
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST SC-28 — protect information at rest

### `rule-9`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_dynamodb_table`
- **Conditions:**
  - Require = true: point_in_time_recovery.enabled
- **Message:** DynamoDB tables must enable point-in-time recovery
- **Rationale:** NIST CP-9 — information system backup
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST CP-9 — information system backup

### `rule-10`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_s3_bucket`
- **Conditions:**
  - Deny `lifecycle.ignore_changes` listing: tags, acl, server_side_encryption
- **Message:** Must not hide drift on security attrs via ignore_changes
- **Rationale:** NIST CM-3 — changes to security configs must be auditable
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST CM-3 — changes to security configs must be auditable

### `rule-11`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** `aws_db_instance`
- **Conditions:**
  - Deny `lifecycle.ignore_changes` listing: storage_encrypted, deletion_protection, master_password
- **Message:** Must not hide drift on DB security attrs via ignore_changes
- **Rationale:** NIST CM-3 — changes to security configs must be auditable
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST CM-3 — changes to security configs must be auditable

### `rule-12`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** all resources
- **Conditions:**
  - Require an exact `terraform.required_version` pin (`= X.Y.Z`)
- **Message:** Terraform required_version must be an exact pin (NIST CM-7)
- **Rationale:** NIST CM-7 — restrict software installation to approved versions
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST CM-7 — restrict software installation to approved versions

### `rule-13`

- **Severity:** ✗ block
- **Resources:** all resources
- **Conditions:**
  - Require a declared + encrypted state backend
- **Message:** State backend must be encrypted (NIST SC-28 — protect state at rest)
- **Rationale:** NIST SC-28 — state files may contain sensitive configuration
- **Framework mapping (derived):** NIST SC-28 — state files may contain sensitive configuration
